landmarks.name: Washington Square Park
landmarks.quote: The core of NYU consists of buildings that surround Washington Square Park.
landmarks.look: An urban park functioning as a central campus quad surrounded by buildings.

landmarks.name: Washington Square Arch
landmarks.quote: The Washington Square Arch is an unofficial symbol of NYU.
landmarks.look: A plain monumental arch standing as a campus symbol.

landmarks.name: Elmer Holmes Bobst Library
landmarks.quote: The Elmer Holmes Bobst Library, built between 1967 and 1972, is the largest library at NYU
landmarks.look: A plain 12-story rectangular library building on the southern edge of the park.

landmarks.name: Jeffrey S. Gould Plaza
landmarks.quote: The Jeffrey S. Gould Plaza, located between Washington Square East and Mercer Street on West 4th Street
landmarks.look: A plain open urban plaza surrounded by academic buildings.

landmarks.name: Vanderbilt Hall
landmarks.quote: Vanderbilt Hall, the main building for the School of Law, is located near the southwest corner of Washington Square
landmarks.look: A plain academic hall near the southwest corner of the square.

landmarks.name: Coral Tower
landmarks.quote: priority residence halls of Carlyle Court, Palladium Residence Hall, Alumni Hall, Coral Tower, Thirteenth Street Hall

landmarks.name: Goddard Hall
landmarks.quote: Undergraduate residence halls in the immediate surroundings of Washington Square include Goddard Hall, Lipton Hall, and Weinstein Hall
landmarks.look: A plain undergraduate residence hall near Washington Square.

landmarks.name: Tamiment Library
landmarks.quote: Bobst Library also houses the Tamiment Library, which holds collections in labor history
landmarks.look: A plain library interior housed within Bobst Library.
